Hi, I'm Hanwen Liu. I'm studying a Master of Business Analytics at Monash University, after a Bachelor of Management in Audit at Nanjing Audit University.

Before analytics, I worked in audit. I interned on an IPO audit at Wuyige Certified Public Accountants in Shanghai, and in internal audit at Lianyungang Orient Rural Commercial Bank, where I cleaned loan write-off records and helped build credit-risk early-warning models. Both roles centred on data validation, risk analysis and internal controls.

Today I work mostly in R, Python and SQL: collecting and cleaning data, running statistical analysis, and building maps and dashboards.

This blog is where I practise the other half of the job: turning research and data into short, plain-language stories that anyone can follow.
